questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, where you position yourself in the lane:

options.text: Does not affect whether other drivers can see you.
Is very important because it affects whether other drivers can see you.
Cannot protect you from wind blasts from other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Is very important because it affects whether other drivers can see you.
questions.explanation: Good lane position helps you see better and be seen better. It also helps you avoid wind from other vehicles.

questions.question: Which material gives the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather and sturdy synthetic materials give the most protection for motorcycle riders.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that right turns are not allowed. Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings.

questions.question: A pre-ride inspection should include everything except:
questions.explanation: Before riding, check the tires, controls, lights, signals, mirrors, brakes, oil, fluids, chassis, and stands. Paint inspection is not necessary.

questions.question: When riding, you should wear:
questions.explanation: Wear bright clothing to be more visible when riding. Reflective materials also help other drivers see you.

questions.question: The best way to stop quickly is to:

options.text: Use both brakes at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both brakes at the same time.
questions.explanation: To stop quickly, apply steady pressure to both the front and rear brakes together.

questions.question: If riding during the day, you should wear:

options.text: Brightly-colored clothing so other drivers can see you.
Any color because daylight makes you easy to see.
Dark clothing to stand out against the sunlight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Brightly-colored clothing so other drivers can see you.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen in daylight. Always wear bright clothing to stay visible to other drivers, even during the day.

questions.question: How can you become sober after drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: Only time will make you sober. Your body needs time to remove alcohol. Nothing else will speed this up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic lanes are merging. Warning signs are yellow with black symbols and tell you about road conditions ahead.

questions.question: Which color makes you less visible to other drivers?
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors like orange, red, yellow, or green. Avoid dark or drab colors when riding.

questions.question: Reflective and brightly-colored helmets and clothing:

options.text: Should only be worn when riding at night.
Help motorcycle riders be more visible.
Do not increase a motorcycle rider's safety.

questions.correctAnswerText: Help motorcycle riders be more visible.
questions.explanation: Brightly-colored or reflective clothing makes it easier for other drivers to see you on the road.

questions.question: When using saddlebags to carry a load, you should:

options.text: Load the bags with equal weight.
Put unequal weight in each saddlebag.
Put as much weight as possible in one saddlebag.

questions.correctAnswerText: Load the bags with equal weight.
questions.explanation: Split the weight evenly between saddlebags. Unequal weight can cause your motorcycle to drift to one side.

questions.question: Wind noise while riding:

options.text: Is easy to get used to.

questions.explanation: Long-term exposure to wind noise can permanently damage your hearing. Wear ear plugs or other hearing protection when riding.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a type of helmet?
questions.explanation: The main helmet types are full-face and three-quarter. Full-face helmets offer the best protection in a crash.

questions.question: A sign that your rear tire has gone flat is:

options.text: The back of your motorcycle sways side to side.

questions.correctAnswerText: The back of your motorcycle sways side to side.
questions.explanation: If your rear tire goes flat, the back of your motorcycle may jerk or sway side to side. Stop riding immediately and check your tires.

questions.question: If vehicles are on both sides of your motorcycle, which lane position is usually safest?
questions.explanation: Good riders change their lane position based on road and traffic conditions. When vehicles are on both sides, the center position is usually safest.

questions.question: When entering a turn, you should:
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed before turning. Taking a turn too fast can cause you to leave your lane or go off the road.

questions.question: If you must stop quickly, you should:

options.text: Use both brakes at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both brakes at the same time.
questions.explanation: Apply steady pressure to both the front and rear brakes at the same time for the quickest stop. Do not lock the brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red traffic light. You must stop and wait for a signal that allows you to turn.

questions.question: When approaching a blind intersection, you should:

options.text: Assume other drivers will yield the right-of-way.
Move to the lane position that makes you most visible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the lane position that makes you most visible.
questions.explanation: At a blind intersection, position yourself where other drivers can see you most easily.

questions.question: What should you do before riding an unfamiliar motorcycle for the first time?

options.text: Just start riding. Learning by doing is the best way.
Just start riding. Most bikes are similar, so you don't need to learn the safety features first.
Practice using the throttle, clutch, and brakes before riding. This helps you learn how the bike works.

questions.correctAnswerText: Practice using the throttle, clutch, and brakes before riding. This helps you learn how the bike works.
questions.explanation: Every motorcycle is different. Do not ride an unfamiliar bike without learning how it works first. Check the safety and maintenance. Find where everything is located. Practice the throttle, clutch, and brakes to learn how the bike handles.

questions.question: Why should you check your mirrors when stopping at an intersection?

options.text: To see if drivers behind you notice that you are stopping.
To look for dark clouds that might mean bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: To see if drivers behind you notice that you are stopping.
questions.explanation: Always check for vehicles approaching from behind. Make sure drivers see you and your motorcycle. Use your mirrors when stopping to confirm that drivers behind you are responding to your actions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane will end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What is required to get a motorcycle endorsement?

options.text: You must have a valid driver's license.
You must be over 21 years old.
You must have no traffic violations on your record.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must have a valid driver's license.
questions.explanation: In Delaware, you must be a licensed driver before you can apply for a motorcycle endorsement.
